synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 6px (A1-4), blocked by wall px in dest box except the plate, and by y<8; first input of a level (counter n==0) is a no-op that logs a stay.
Counter loses 1px on odd calls (hidden parity, continuity-gated; fallback n=2(64-w)-1, or 0 at w=64).
Plate (topmost 3x3) covered by player/ghost -> key/arm rows left of the line shift +6 toward it; wall cropped under layer-1 boxes; names type_{index:03d}.
A5 off spawn (14,8): no ghost -> record life path (start + successful moves), red hud (1,1), white huds x+4; ghost -> clear; player -> spawn.
Step-43 fix: ghost = recorded path[k], k = successful moves since record, hidden on the player (life starting at spawn puts path[1] under the player). Unconfirmed: first-input no-op vs an invisible cell at (20,14); stateless 19/44.
